What is missing or improvable, cross-checked against the vision and branding documents.

The app was built feature by feature, and nobody has yet sat down and used it as a stranger with a
question. The product test in [VISION_ROADMAP_IDEAS.md](../../docs/VISION_ROADMAP_IDEAS.md) is the
right lens: *a plausible visitor question that cannot be answered by changing a filter is a gap.*

**Done when**

- [ ] Each of the five product-test questions walked through end to end
- [ ] Findings filed as their own issues rather than fixed inline — this pass is the survey, not the
      remediation
